background.use: backgrounds, panels and dark fills, as a deep, dark shade of it

accent.use: glows, outlines, rim light, icons and connecting lines

highlight.use: the highlight words and big numbers

text.use: all other text, the CTA label, arrows and chevrons

core.fonts: Use the heading font for headlines, the audience line and big numbers, and the body font for all other text.
core.headingFont: Set in {font}, the brand heading font: a geometric sans of normal width, never condensed, narrow or compressed.
core.layout: Fill the whole canvas: no large empty areas. Size every text to read easily on a phone: the headline large, other text never tiny.
core.footer: Small, in the text colour, centred at the bottom edge on its own: the handle or website.
core.audienceLine: A small ALL-CAPS line in the accent colour just above the headline: who this is for.
core.logo: Keep the top-right corner empty (a box about 30% of the width wide and 15% of the height tall): plain background only, no text, icons, decor, panel edges or busy detail. The approved logo version that contrasts with the background is placed there afterwards. Do not draw any logo, wordmark, monogram or brand name anywhere.
core.sceneText: No readable text in the scene: screens, phones, laptops, tablets, signs, papers and packaging show only abstract shapes, blurred interface blocks or simple icons, never letters, words or numbers.
core.sourceLine: Small, in the body font and the text colour, directly under the big number.

rules: The only person allowed in this image is the man in {images}; nobody else appears.
He is that exact person: same face, facial structure, hairline and hair, skin tone and age.
Do not beautify, idealize or change him.
Do not add glasses, a beard or accessories that are not in the references.
His face comes only from these photos. Any person, face, body part or logo in any other reference image is ignored and never copied.
identity.split: Both halves of the split show this same person.

core.noPerson: No people, faces or human figures anywhere: no hands, silhouettes, bystanders, crowds, mannequins or human-shaped holograms.

text.only: Render ONLY the texts listed here, exactly as written, sharp and correctly spelled, in {language}, and nothing else:
text.nothingElse: Do not add any other words, letters, numbers, labels, buttons, captions or watermarks.
text.none: Do not render any words, labels, buttons, captions or watermarks.
text.noButton: Do not draw a CTA button.
text.lettering: The only other lettering allowed is {lettering}; screens, holograms and props show icons and abstract shapes, never words.
text.noLettering: No other lettering anywhere; screens, holograms and props show icons and abstract shapes, never words.

core.bodyFont: Set in {font}, the brand body font: medium weight, normal width.

brandRules.colours: Only the brand colours listed here and their lighter tints or deeper shades; no other hue anywhere in graphics, glows, icons, panels or text (no purple, teal, green, orange or gold). Blue gradients are paired with silver/metallic accents, as in the logo. The photo scene is colour-graded cool and neutral (blue, white and grey tones) to match.
brandRules.typography: Exactly two type styles, identical on every image of the set: {heading} for the headline, the audience line and big numbers; {body} for all other text (supporting line, key points, chat, labels, button, footer). Each role keeps the same size, weight and case on every image. Never condensed, narrow, rounded, serif, script or decorative fonts, never the logo font, no outlined, 3D or distorted text.
brandRules.spacing: Even outer margins of about 6% of the width on every side; only the background touches the edges. Text is left-aligned on one margin line inside the panel with generous line spacing; elements sit on a simple grid with even gaps; at most three small decor elements; no clutter and no large empty areas.

typography.headline: ALL CAPS, bold, left-aligned, 2-4 short lines.
typography.headlineHighlight: The highlight words are set in the highlight colour.
typography.subheadlineHighlight: The one highlight word is set in the highlight colour.
typography.stat: Huge and extra-bold, in the highlight colour.
typography.steps: Medium weight, sentence case, one line per step.
typography.points: One line per point, sentence case, each with a small outlined glowing icon in the accent colour on its left.

elements.textPanel: A dark translucent glass panel with rounded corners, a thin glowing outline in the accent colour and a slanted inner edge. It holds all text.

ctaButton.description: A rounded rectangle at the bottom right with a dark fill, a glowing border in the accent colour and its label in the text colour, with a small icon beside the label.
ctaButton.pointer: Optionally a small arrow or a row of chevrons in the text colour points at the button.

elements.iconRow: A row of 3-4 outlined, glowing circle icons, each with its 1-2 word label underneath.
elements.hologramsPerson: Where his pose allows, the man looks at or gestures towards the holograms.

A.description: Text panel on the left; on the right a large floating system visual (a chat window, CRM card or calendar) with the man beside it, gesturing towards it.

B.description: Text panel on the left, the man on the right.

C.use: trust / authority; alternate with B for variety
C.description: The man on the left, text panel on the right.

D.description: Before/after diagonal split: on the left the man stressed at a dark, cluttered desk; on the right the same man relaxed in a bright office; a round "»" button sits in the middle of the split. The text panel sits in the lower part and covers neither face.

ad.use: an offer or service message with a call to action: headline, subheadline and CTA button, always with the man
ad.composition: A premium tech-style graphic with a rich composition and no large empty areas. All text sits in the text panel; the layout decides where the man and, in layout A, the system visual stand.

statement.use: content type insight: one bold claim or insight and 3 ways to act on it
statement.composition: Content type insight: the headline is one bold claim; the 3 key points say how to act on it.

stat.use: content type stat: one sourced number from the research and what it means
stat.composition: Content type stat: the content block is the one big number with its source line.

news.use: content type news: a news item from the research, what it means, and 3 things to do now
news.composition: Content type news: the headline is the news in one line; the supporting line says what it means for the reader; the 3 key points are what to do now.

carousel.use: a topic taught in slides: a hook slide with the man, tip slides, and a last slide with the call to action
carousel.composition: One slide of a carousel; every slide shares the same background, text panel and decor so the series looks consistent.

person_photo.use: a human or behind-the-scenes moment: the man in a scene with almost no text
person_photo.composition: A photorealistic photo of the man in the scene, like a professional portrait or lifestyle shot with natural depth of field. No text panel and no graphics over the photo: only the logo, plus the small caption if one is listed below.

typography.headline: Small, bold, ALL CAPS, one line in a lower corner.

checklist.use: content type checklist: a task in 3 numbered steps
checklist.composition: Content type checklist: the headline names the task; the 3 key points are numbered steps.

organic.description: an organic social media post graphic: educational, with one clear idea

ad.description: a social media advertisement graphic: one message, one offer and one call to action, with short text

story.safeZone: Keep the top 13% and the bottom 13% of the frame free of text, logo and buttons; only background and decor continue there. The logo corner sits at the top right just below the top safe zone.

carousel_slide.description: one slide of a social media carousel

slides.hook: The first slide, the hook, with the man: the audience line, then a big ALL-CAPS headline that names the problem or the promise (1-2 highlight words), with an optional short line below. No tip and no button.
slides.tip: A middle slide, an information visual without people: the heading (ALL CAPS, bold, at most 2 lines, the same style as on the first slide) with highlight words, a short accent-coloured underline, the supporting line with the concrete fact or action, and one large visual that adds information (listed below). No button.
slides.cta: The last slide, with the man: the call to action as the headline and the CTA button as the focal point; optionally a row of three outlined icons (heart, paper plane, bookmark) without words.

carousel.chat: A phone-style chat on the right: the listed bubbles in order, customer bubbles on the left in a dark grey, business or chatbot bubbles on the right in the accent colour, each with its text exactly as listed.
carousel.diagram: A simple workflow diagram on the right: the listed steps as 3-4 rounded glass boxes connected by glowing arrows in order, each box with a small icon and its label exactly as listed.
carousel.navigation: No slide numbers, counters, page dots or counts anywhere. A small row of swipe chevrons at the bottom right on every slide except the last.

demos.source: assets/reference/creative/carousels: 13 demo carousels of 8 slides each (video frames in _frames/). Slide 1 is used as a hook example, the last slide as a call-to-action example and the slides between as tip examples.
demos.structure: Dark background with a glowing particle-dot wave, faint hexagon lines and small dot grids; text left or centred, the visual on the right. Hook: a large statement headline. Tips: a headline with highlight words, a short underline, a short explanation and often a small hexagon icon with a one-line takeaway. Last slide: a question that invites comments, an engagement icon row and the logo. A counter pill like 02/07 marks the slide; there is no visible swipe text.

carousel.checklist: A mini checklist on the right: exactly 3 rows in a glass card, each a check-box icon in the accent colour and its label exactly as listed.
carousel.beforeAfter: A before/after comparison on the right: two stacked glass cards joined by a glowing arrow; the top card has a small cross icon and the before text, the bottom card a check icon and the after text, each exactly as listed.
carousel.series: Every slide of this carousel uses the same design: the same glass panel, the same two fonts and sizes, the same palette and the same scene treatment (on the middle slides the scene of the first slide, softly blurred and darkened behind the panel). Only the texts and the visual change.

story.hook: slide 1: names the audience and the problem or the promise (with the man)
story.problem: slide 2: what goes wrong today, concretely (who waits, what is lost)
story.step: a step to take: who sends what, when, through which channel
story.insight: a usable insight: a timing, a tool setting, example wording or a sourced figure
story.example: second to last: a concrete example run-through (a message thread or a day)
story.result: second to last: what changes, with a sourced figure or a concrete scenario
story.cta: last slide: the call to action with the offer (with the man)

instagram.use: Ask for a comment with one keyword, a save, or a DM; never a "Learn more" button. Use the offer from brand/services.md.

facebook.use: Point to the link in the caption. Use the offer from brand/services.md.

headlineFormulas.principle: Automate The Routine, Keep The Strategy
headlineFormulas.question: Still Answering Every Lead Manually?

organic: Soft CTA where the format has one, such as "Learn more", "Read now" or "Swipe →".
ad: One message, one offer, one CTA.
Use offer words: free, analysis, demo, in 15 minutes.
At most one proof number, and only from brand/proof.md; without proof there, use a concrete scenario instead of a number.
3 variants: a different headline or visual, the same branding.

postFamily.use: every Facebook post: one premium layout family; statement, stat, checklist and news are its content types
postFamily.composition: A premium social post in the quality of the brand's past ads: the man integrated in a topic-relevant scene with depth (softly blurred background, a few foreground props) and brand lighting (cool blue key light, sky-blue rim light); a dark translucent glass panel holds the audience line, the headline and one supporting line, then the content block; topic-relevant hologram or UI elements (a chat window, a CRM card, a calendar) float near him; the footer at the bottom. No flat single-colour background and no large empty areas.
postFamily.compositionNoPerson: A premium social post in the quality of the brand's past ads, with no person in it: a topic-relevant scene with depth (softly blurred background, a few foreground props) and brand lighting (cool blue key light, sky-blue rim light); a dark translucent glass panel holds the audience line, the headline and one supporting line, then the content block; topic-relevant hologram or UI elements (a chat window, a CRM card, a calendar) float in the scene; the footer at the bottom. No flat single-colour background and no large empty areas.
postFamily.points: Content block: the 3 key points listed below, one per line, each with its icon.
postFamily.stat: Content block: the one big number, huge and bold in the highlight colour, with the small source line directly under it.

left.label: the left side of the frame

right.label: the right side of the frame

bottom.label: the lower part of the frame

caption.label: a small strip in the lower left corner

prompt.noText: Do not render any text at all: no words, letters, numbers, labels, buttons, captions, logos, wordmarks, monograms or watermarks anywhere, including on screens, holograms, props, signs and clothing. The app adds all text afterwards.
prompt.space: Keep these areas as clean, calm negative space for that text: {areas}. There the scene is smooth, darker and evenly lit (soft blur or a plain background) with no face, hands, props, holograms, decor, panels, boxes, frames or busy detail.
prompt.canvas: Fill the whole canvas with the scene; apart from the text areas, no large empty areas.
prompt.post: A premium social post in the quality of the brand's past ads: the man integrated in a topic-relevant scene with depth (softly blurred background, a few foreground props) and brand lighting (cool blue key light, sky-blue rim light); topic-relevant hologram or UI elements (a chat window, a CRM card, a calendar) float near him, away from the text areas. No flat single-colour background.
prompt.postNoPerson: A premium social post in the quality of the brand's past ads, with no person in it: a topic-relevant scene with depth (softly blurred background, a few foreground props) and brand lighting (cool blue key light, sky-blue rim light); topic-relevant hologram or UI elements (a chat window, a CRM card, a calendar) float in the scene, away from the text areas. No flat single-colour background.

compositions.ad: A premium tech-style graphic with a rich composition; the layout decides where the man and, in layout A, the system visual stand, and the text areas stay calm.
compositions.person_photo: A photorealistic photo of the man in the scene, like a professional portrait or lifestyle shot with natural depth of field. No text panel and no graphics over the photo.

layouts.A: On the right a large floating system visual (a chat window, CRM card or calendar) with the man beside it, gesturing towards it; the left side stays calm for the text.
layouts.B: The man on the right; the left side stays calm for the text.
layouts.C: The man on the left; the right side stays calm for the text.
layouts.D: Before/after diagonal split: on the left the man stressed at a dark, cluttered desk; on the right the same man relaxed in a bright office; a round button with a double-chevron arrow shape sits in the middle of the split. The lower part stays calm for the text, below both faces.
